mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_case_view v WHERE v.case_id = c.id) AS view_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_case_like l WHERE l.case_id = c.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_case_comment m WHERE m.case_id = c.id AND m.deleted = FALSE) AS comment_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(v.duration_seconds), 0) FROM dtl_case_view v WHERE v.case_id = c.id) AS read_seconds
mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, owner.employee_name AS owner_name, reviewer.employee_name AS reviewer_name,
FROM biz_case c LEFT JOIN org_employee owner ON owner.employee_no = c.owner_no AND owner.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN org_employee reviewer ON reviewer.employee_no = c.reviewer_no AND reviewer.deleted = FALSE WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = FALSE
